title: std::scoped_allocator_adaptor<OuterAlloc,InnerAlloc...>::max_size
summary: Reports the maximum allocation size supported by the outer allocator, by calling std::allocator_traits<OuterAlloc>::max_size(outer_allocator()).
html:
Defined in header <scoped_allocator>
size_type max_size() const;
 (since C++11)

Reports the maximum allocation size supported by the outer allocator, by calling std::allocator_traits<OuterAlloc>::max_size(outer_allocator()).

Parameters

(none)

Return value

The maximum allocation size for OuterAlloc.
